questions.prompt: Which of these countries share a land border with Germany?
questions.fact: Germany has nine land neighbours, from Denmark in the north round to Austria and Switzerland in the south.

questions.prompt: Which of these are capital cities today?
questions.fact: Canberra was built from scratch as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne. Rio lost the title to Brasilia in 1960, and Istanbul lost it to Ankara in 1923.

questions.prompt: How tall is Mount Everest above sea level?
questions.fact: 8,849 m by the 2020 China and Nepal survey, and still rising by about 4 mm a year.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest desert outside the polar regions?
questions.hint: It covers most of North Africa.
questions.fact: Antarctica is the largest desert of all. A desert is defined by how little rain falls, not by sand.

questions.prompt: Which country has the most islands?
questions.hint: Think Scandinavia, and count the tiny ones.
questions.fact: Sweden counts about 267,000 islands, and only around a thousand of them are inhabited.
